ps.en: When doctors warned that a new fever was [[imminent]], the town near the [[border]] grew quiet. No one was [[immune]] to it, and the [[likelihood]] of a rapid spread seemed high. The virus would [[likely]] cross the river within days, and the neighbouring towns would [[likewise]] suffer.
ps.zh: 当医生警告说新一轮发热疫情即将来临时，边境附近的小镇安静了下来。没人能幸免于感染，疫情迅速蔓延的可能性看起来很高。病毒很可能在几天内跨过界河，邻近的村镇也会同样遭殃。

ps.en: Under such [[circumstances|circumstance]], some thought only of the [[self]], and one [[selfish]] merchant began to hoard masks. Thick smoke from his warehouse [[choked|choke]] the narrow streets at night, as if fear itself had taken physical form. When reporters came, he would [[cite]] a dozen excuses and [[claim]] that the masks were meant for charity.
ps.zh: 在这样的处境下，有人只顾着自己——一个自私的商人开始囤积口罩。夜里，他仓库里冒出的浓烟呛得狭窄的街道令人窒息，仿佛恐惧本身化成了实体。记者上门时，他搬出一堆借口，声称这些口罩是要捐给慈善机构的。

ps.en: The mayor decided to [[chop]] the hoarder's supply contract and open the town's stores to everyone. Within a week the roads were [[clear]] again, and volunteers stood at the border bridge handing out medicine. The crisis had tested the town, but it also taught people what they truly shared.
ps.zh: 镇长决定砍掉这个囤积者的供货合同，把镇里的储备向所有人开放。一周内道路重新畅通，志愿者们站在边境桥头分发药品。这场危机考验了小镇，也教会了人们彼此真正共享的是什么。

ps.en: Lin was [[born]] into a family of dock workers, and as a child she found every lecture a [[bore]]. Few classmates [[bothered|bother]] to talk with the quiet girl who repaired radios after school. Yet it was in that dusty repair shop that she began to [[acquire]] real engineering skills.
ps.zh: 琳出身于码头工人家庭，小时候她觉得每场讲座都乏味透顶。没几个同学愿意费心跟这个放学后修收音机的安静女孩说话。然而正是在那间满是灰尘的修理铺里，她开始学到真正的工程技术。

ps.en: Ten years later her small robot firm caught the eye of a giant, and the [[acquisition]] offer arrived on a gray Monday. She knew she had to [[act]] before the board lost patience. Her first [[action]] was to [[activate]] the old workshop network, turning every former apprentice into an [[active]] partner.
ps.zh: 十年后，她的小型机器人公司引起了一家巨头的注意，收购要约在一个灰蒙蒙的周一送抵。她知道必须在董事会失去耐心之前行动。她的第一步举措是重新启用旧车间的学徒网络，把每位昔日的学徒都变成积极的合伙人。

ps.en: The sudden burst of [[activity]] doubled output, though the [[actual]] figures were still modest. A cash crisis remained [[acute]], and some investors began to [[despise]] her stubborn independence. [[Despite|despite]] the pressure, she declined the offer—and two years later her company bought the giant's failing division instead.
ps.zh: 突如其来的忙碌景象让产量翻了一番，尽管实际数字仍然不算起眼。资金危机依旧严峻，一些投资人开始鄙视她固执的独立。尽管压力重重，她还是拒绝了要约——两年后，她的公司反过来买下了巨头那个衰败的部门。

ps.en: Mara, an [[energetic]] young engineer, came to the fishing village to build a tidal [[energy]] station. The village [[folk]] liked her, though few understood her machines. She tried to [[engage]] them in the work, and this [[engagement]] slowly turned doubt into trust.
ps.zh: 玛拉是一位精力充沛的年轻工程师，她来到渔村建一座潮汐能源电站。村里人都喜欢她，尽管没几个人懂她的机器。她努力让村民参与到工程里，这种参与慢慢把怀疑变成了信任。

ps.en: The investors, however, threatened to withdraw, and the project nearly [[folded|fold]] before spring. Mara chose to [[follow]] the rules rather than complain, and the [[following]] week she persuaded the town to [[enforce]] a new safety code. That decision proved a quiet [[force]] that kept the whole team together.
ps.zh: 然而投资人威胁要撤资，项目差点在春天之前就夭折。玛拉选择遵守规则而不是抱怨，随后一周，她说服镇政府强制推行一套新的安全规范。这个决定成了一股安静的力量，把整个团队凝聚在一起。

ps.en: Then the [[forecast]] warned of a violent storm, one no one could have [[foreseen|foresee]]. The crew moved the turbines to the [[fore]] of the harbor wall and braced for the worst. When the storm passed with the station intact, the village knew she had helped [[forge]] something stronger than steel.
ps.zh: 随后天气预报警告将有一场猛烈风暴，没人能预见到它的到来。船员们把涡轮机挪到防波堤的前端，做好了最坏的准备。风暴过后电站完好无损，村里人明白，她帮忙铸就的东西比钢铁还要坚固。

ps.en: The report on the district's economy was [[grim]], and Mr. Chen read it twice in his bakery. He tried to [[grasp]] what the falling numbers meant for the [[group]] of shops on his street. Fear began to [[grip]] every owner, and the bank seemed to [[guard]] its vaults more closely than ever.
ps.zh: 关于这个城区经济的报告十分严峻，陈先生在自家面包店里读了两遍。他试图弄清这些下跌的数字对街上这一群店铺意味着什么。恐惧揪住了每位店主，银行似乎把金库看得比以往任何时候都紧。

ps.en: The bakery's [[gross]] earnings had shrunk, and the rent was paid on shaky [[ground]]. When the bank demanded a [[guarantee]] for the new loan, Chen insisted the terms must [[include]] every shop on the street, not just his own. He worked to [[incorporate]] the nine stores into one [[inclusive]] cooperative, so that no family would be left out.
ps.zh: 面包店的总收入缩水了，房租的支付也根基不稳。当银行要求为新贷款提供担保时，陈先生坚持贷款条款必须涵盖街上的每一家店，而不只是他自己。他努力把这九家店合并成一个人人都能加入的合作社，不让任何家庭掉队。

ps.en: Within a year the cooperative's [[income]] began to [[increase]] steadily. It was [[incredible]] how shared delivery routes and joint advertising cut the costs they used to [[incur]] alone. The street grew [[increasingly]] busy, and the bakery that once feared ruin now taught other districts its recipe for survival.
ps.zh: 一年之内，合作社的收入开始稳步增长。共享配送路线和联合广告削减了他们过去独自承担的成本，这简直令人难以置信。这条街日益繁忙，那家曾经害怕倒闭的面包店，如今在向其他城区传授自己的生存之道。

ps.en: Professor Han was not only a scholar of [[literature]] but also the [[mentor]] who changed Yue's life. His own [[literary]] journey had begun in a village school without a single novel. He often said the [[link]] between a reader and a book is [[literally]] a form of friendship.
ps.zh: 韩教授不仅是文学学者，更是改变了小岳一生的导师。他自己的文学之旅始于一所连一本小说都没有的乡村学校。他常说，读者与书之间的纽带确实就是一种友谊。

ps.en: Before he retired, he left Yue a [[memo]] listing the books that mattered most, a careful [[list]] she kept in her notebook. He never failed to [[mention]] that reading trains the [[mental]] muscles as sport trains the body. On weekends they walked to the old [[memorial]] hall, where he shared every [[memory]] of his student years.
ps.zh: 退休前，他给小岳留了一张便笺，上面列着最重要的那些书——这份清单她一直收在笔记本里。他总不忘提到，阅读锻炼思维的肌肉，正如运动锻炼身体。周末他们散步到那座旧纪念堂，在那里他分享自己学生时代的每一段回忆。

ps.en: Some students chose [[other]] careers, but he warned them not to abandon books, [[otherwise]] they would lose a quiet refuge. Years later, when Yue herself became a teacher, she saw the [[outcome]] of his patience in her own classroom. She finally understood that a true mentor does not give answers; he plants questions.
ps.zh: 有些学生选择了别的职业，但他告诫他们不要丢下书本，否则他们会失去一处安静的庇护所。多年后，当小岳自己也成为教师，她在自己的课堂上看到了他耐心的成果。她终于明白，真正的导师不给答案，而是播下问题。

ps.en: On her first day as studio manager, An was asked to [[sign]] a contract she barely understood. Her [[signature]] at the bottom would [[signal]] the start of a huge project. No one explained its [[significance]], though everyone agreed it was the studio's most [[significant]] deal in years.
ps.zh: 安出任工作室经理的第一天，就被要求在一份她几乎看不懂的合同上签字。她在末尾的签名将标志着一个大项目的启动。没人解释这份合同的意义，尽管人人都认为这是工作室多年来最重大的一笔交易。

ps.en: The contract was forty pages of [[similar]] clauses, and not a single one was [[simple]]. An spent the weekend trying to [[simplify]] the terms, convinced that [[simplicity]] would protect both sides better than jargon. What the dense paragraphs [[signified|signify]], she discovered, could be said in one honest page.
ps.zh: 合同长达四十页，尽是相似的条款，没有一条是简单的。安花了整个周末精简这些条款，她相信简洁比行话更能保护双方。她发现，那些密密麻麻的段落所表达的意思，用一页诚恳的文字就能说清。

ps.en: Business had been [[slack]] that winter, so the partners were nervous about any change. Yet when the client read the shorter draft, he [[simply]] smiled and signed at once. An learned that courage sometimes means removing words rather than adding them.
ps.zh: 那年冬天生意萧条，合伙人们对任何改动都很紧张。然而客户读完更短的草案，只是笑了笑，当即签了字。安明白了：勇气有时意味着删去文字，而不是堆砌文字。

c: an imminent threat 迫在眉睫的威胁
the imminent arrival of ... …的即将来临
imminent danger 迫在眉睫的危险
words.dif: imminent 强调（多为坏事）即将发生；impending 更近'悬在头上'；approaching 只表示靠近，无紧迫感
words.pat: With the deadline imminent, the whole team worked through the night.
words.patZh: 截止日期迫在眉睫，整个团队通宵工作。

words.exam: 免除的；豁免的；不受影响的；免疫的；有免疫力的
c: be immune to ... 不受…影响；对…免疫
immune from prosecution 免于起诉
words.dif: be immune to 侧重'不受影响'；be exempt from 侧重'被免除（义务、税）'
words.pat: No industry is entirely immune to economic cycles.
words.patZh: 没有行业能完全不受经济周期的影响。

words.exam: 大概；多半；很可能的；有希望的
c: be likely to do sth 很可能做某事
most likely 多半；十有八九
words.dif: likely 可作形容词和副词；probable 只作形容词，且不说 sb is probable to do
words.pat: Companies that invest in people are more likely to survive a crisis.
words.patZh: 肯在员工身上投资的公司更可能挺过危机。

c: the likelihood of ... …的可能性
in all likelihood 十有八九
words.dif: likelihood 是正式书面语；chance 更口语，且常指运气成分
words.pat: The likelihood of success rises with every honest review.
words.patZh: 每一次坦诚的复盘都会提高成功的可能性。

c: do likewise 照样做
likewise, ... 同样地，……（句首过渡）
words.dif: likewise 是正式的过渡副词；similarly 更强调两者可比
words.pat: The first factory cut waste by half, and the second did likewise.
words.patZh: 第一家工厂把浪费减半，第二家也照样做到了。

c: one's true self 真实的自我
a sense of self 自我意识
words.dif: self 指'自我、本性'；ego 带心理学色彩，常含'自负'意味
words.pat: Travel often helps people rediscover their true selves.
words.patZh: 旅行常帮助人们重新发现真实的自我。

c: a selfish act 自私的行为
be selfish with ... 在…上自私
words.dif: selfish 指损人利己；self-centered 只强调以自我为中心，未必损人
words.pat: Sharing resources is hard for the selfish but natural for the generous.
words.patZh: 分享资源对自私者很难，对慷慨者却很自然。

words.exam: 使（某人）停止呼吸；窒息；抑制
c: choke on ... 被…噎住
choke back tears 强忍住泪水
choke off ... 压制…的发展
fam: choked adj. 哽咽的；堵塞的
words.dif: choke 多指气管被堵或感情被压抑；suffocate 强调缺氧窒息
words.pat: Excessive regulation may choke off innovation in small firms.
words.patZh: 过度监管可能会压制小公司的创新。

c: chop down ... 砍倒…
chop ... into pieces 把…剁成块
budget chops 预算削减
words.dif: chop 指用力劈砍或大幅削减；trim 指小幅修剪；slash 语气最猛，常配 budget
words.pat: The government decided to chop its spending on outdated projects.
words.patZh: 政府决定砍掉在过时项目上的开支。

c: under such circumstances 在这种情况下
under no circumstances 绝不（倒装标志）
a victim of circumstance 环境的牺牲品
fam: circumstantial adj. 间接的；依情况而定的
words.dif: circumstance 常用复数指客观处境；situation 泛指形势；context 强调背景脉络
words.pat: Under no circumstances should personal data be sold without consent.
words.patZh: 绝不应在未经同意的情况下出售个人数据。

c: cite ... as evidence 援引…作为证据
cite an example 举例
words.dif: cite 强调正式援引以作证据；quote 强调原话照录
words.pat: The report cites several cases to support its conclusion.
words.patZh: 这份报告援引了多个案例来支撑结论。

c: claim to do sth 声称做某事
make a claim for ... 就…提出索赔
lay claim to ... 声称对…拥有权利
fam: claimant n. 索赔人；申请人
words.dif: claim 指'声称'但未必属实；declare 是公开正式宣布；allege 指无证据的指控
words.pat: Critics claim that the policy benefits only large companies.
words.patZh: 批评者声称这项政策只让大公司受益。

words.exam: 清楚地；清晰地；通畅的；无阻的
c: be clear about ... 对…清楚明白
clear away ... 清除…
keep clear of ... 避开…
words.dif: clear 泛指'明白、无阻碍'；obvious 强调'显而易见，不用多想'
words.pat: Only when the facts are clear can a fair decision be made.
words.patZh: 只有事实清楚，才能作出公正的决定。

c: across the border 越过边境
border on ... 与…接壤；近似于…
fam: borderline n. 分界线；adj. 临界的
words.dif: border 指国与国之间的边境地带；boundary 泛指任何分界线；frontier 带'边疆、前沿'色彩
words.pat: Trade across the border has doubled since the agreement was signed.
words.patZh: 自协议签署以来，跨境贸易翻了一番。

words.exam: 令人讨厌的人（或事）；使厌烦
c: a complete bore 十足的无聊事
bore sb to death 把某人烦透了
words.dif: bore 作名词指'烦人的人或事'；boring 是形容词修饰物；bored 形容人的感受
words.pat: To a curious mind, no subject is ever a bore.
words.patZh: 对一颗好奇的心来说，没有哪门学科是无聊的事。

c: be born into ... 出生于…（家庭）
be born to do sth 天生适合做某事
a born leader 天生的领导者
words.dif: born 只用于 be born 结构；innate / inborn 可直接作定语，指'与生俱来的'
words.pat: No one is born confident; confidence is built through practice.
words.patZh: 没有人生来自信，自信是在练习中养成的。

c: bother to do sth 费心去做某事
bother sb with ... 拿…烦扰某人
sorry to bother you 抱歉打扰一下
words.dif: bother 程度最轻，常指小烦扰；disturb 指打断秩序；annoy 强调惹人生气
words.pat: Great learners bother to ask why, not just what.
words.patZh: 优秀的学习者费心追问'为什么'，而不只是'是什么'。

c: acquire knowledge 获得知识
acquire a taste for ... 逐渐喜欢上…
acquire a company 收购一家公司
words.dif: acquire 强调通过努力逐步获得；obtain 是通用的'取得'；gain 常配利益、经验
words.pat: It takes years to acquire the skills that a craft demands.
words.patZh: 掌握一门手艺所需的技能要花上数年。

c: mergers and acquisitions 并购
the acquisition of ... …的获得；对…的收购
words.dif: acquisition 泛指'获得'，商业上专指收购；takeover 强调取得控制权
words.pat: Language acquisition is fastest in early childhood.
words.patZh: 语言习得在幼年时期最快。

c: act on ... 按…行事；对…起作用
act as ... 充当…
in the act of ... 正在做…时
words.dif: act 多指具体的一次行为或'行动'；behave 指一贯的举止表现
words.pat: The best time to act on good advice is the moment you hear it.
words.patZh: 按好建议行动的最佳时机，就是听到它的那一刻。

c: take action 采取行动
put ... into action 把…付诸行动
course of action 行动方案
words.dif: action 指抽象或连续的'行动'；act 指具体的一次行为
words.pat: Words without action rarely change anything.
words.patZh: 没有行动的言语很少能改变什么。

c: activate an account 激活账户
activate one's memory 唤起某人的记忆
words.dif: activate 强调'使从静止转入工作'；trigger 强调引发连锁反应
words.pat: A good story can activate parts of the brain that data cannot reach.
words.patZh: 一个好故事能激活大脑中数据触达不到的区域。

c: take an active part in ... 积极参与…
active in ... 在…方面活跃
an active volcano 活火山
words.dif: active 泛指'活跃、积极'；energetic 强调精力充沛；positive 强调态度乐观
words.pat: Students who take an active part in class learn more deeply.
words.patZh: 课堂上积极参与的学生学得更深入。

c: economic activity 经济活动
a burst of activity 一阵忙碌
outdoor activities 户外活动
words.dif: activity 泛指各类活动；campaign 指有组织、有目标的系列活动
words.pat: Regular physical activity benefits both body and mind.
words.patZh: 规律的身体活动对身心都有益。

c: the actual cost 实际成本
in actual fact 事实上
words.dif: actual 强调'实际发生的'；real 强调'真实非假'；true 强调'符合事实'
words.pat: The actual result exceeded everyone's expectations.
words.patZh: 实际结果超出了所有人的预期。

words.exam: 有观察力的；敏锐的；激烈的；严重的
c: an acute shortage of ... …的严重短缺
an acute crisis 严峻的危机
acute pain 剧痛
fam: acutely adv. 严重地；敏锐地
words.dif: acute 指'急性的、严峻的'；chronic 是其反义，指'慢性的、长期的'
words.pat: The region faces an acute shortage of clean water.
words.patZh: 该地区面临清洁用水的严重短缺。

c: despise sb for ... 因…鄙视某人
despise doing sth 鄙视做某事
words.dif: despise 语气强烈，指发自内心的蔑视；dislike 只是'不喜欢'
words.pat: Honest workers despise those who take credit for others' efforts.
words.patZh: 踏实做事的人鄙视那些窃取他人功劳的人。

c: despite the fact that ... 尽管…
despite doing sth 尽管做了某事
words.dif: despite 是介词后接名词；although 是连词后接句子，二者不能混用
words.pat: Despite limited resources, the team finished the project on time.
words.patZh: 尽管资源有限，团队还是按时完成了项目。

c: an energetic young man 精力充沛的年轻人
be energetic in ... 在…上劲头十足
words.dif: energetic 形容人精力足；dynamic 强调有推动力、有变革力
words.pat: An energetic start often decides the tone of a whole project.
words.patZh: 一个劲头十足的开端往往决定整个项目的基调。

c: save energy 节约能源
devote one's energy to ... 把精力投入…
renewable energy 可再生能源
words.dif: energy 既指人的精力也指能源；power 强调功率与权力；strength 指体力
words.pat: Much of our energy should go to problems that truly matter.
words.patZh: 我们的大部分精力应当投入到真正重要的问题上。

c: enforce a law 执法
enforce ... on sb 把…强加给某人
strictly enforce 严格执行
fam: force n. / v. 强迫；力量
words.dif: enforce 强调'强制使生效'（配法律规则）；implement 强调'落实'（配计划政策）
words.pat: Rules mean little unless they are fairly enforced.
words.patZh: 规则若得不到公正执行，就意义不大。

words.exam: 与…建立密切关系；吸引；占用
c: engage sb in ... 让某人参与…
engage in ... 从事；参加…
engage one's attention 吸引某人的注意
fam: engaged adj. 忙碌的；已订婚的
words.dif: engage in 指正式'从事、参与'；join in 更口语，指临时加入
words.pat: Good teachers engage every student in the discussion.
words.patZh: 好老师会让每个学生都参与到讨论中。

c: public engagement 公众参与
an engagement ring 订婚戒指
a prior engagement 先前的约
words.dif: engagement 既可指'订婚'也可指'参与'，靠语境区分；appointment 只指约会
words.pat: Real change begins with the engagement of ordinary citizens.
words.patZh: 真正的改变始于普通公民的参与。

c: fold up ... 把…折叠起来
fold one's arms 双臂交叉
the company folded 公司倒闭了
words.dif: fold 指企业'倒闭'是引申义；bankrupt 强调法律意义上的破产
words.pat: Many small firms folded during the long recession.
words.patZh: 许多小公司在漫长的衰退中倒闭了。

c: ordinary folk 普通百姓
folk music 民间音乐
old folk 老人（口）
words.dif: folk 作名词常用复数 folks 指'人们'；作定语指'民间的'（folk art）
words.pat: The festival draws folk from every corner of the county.
words.patZh: 这个节日吸引着县里四面八方的人们。

words.exam: 跟随；领会；沿着…前进；遵循
c: follow the rules 遵守规则
follow one's advice 听从某人的建议
as follows 如下
words.dif: follow 是通用词；obey 强调服从权威；comply with 是正式书面语
words.pat: Those who follow the data rather than the crowd often see further.
words.patZh: 跟随数据而非人群的人，往往看得更远。

c: the following day 第二天
the following points 以下几点
words.dif: the following 后接单复数均可（the following day / days）；next 前常加 the
words.pat: The following examples show how small habits shape big results.
words.patZh: 下面的例子说明小习惯如何塑造大结果。

c: force sb to do sth 强迫某人做某事
come into force 生效
work force 劳动力
words.dif: force 泛指力量或强迫；power 强调支配力；strength 强调强度
words.pat: Education is the most powerful force for social mobility.
words.patZh: 教育是推动社会流动的最强大力量。

c: come to the fore 崭露头角；走到台前
to the fore 在显著位置
words.dif: fore 单用多见于航海与固定搭配 come to the fore；front 是通用的'前面'
words.pat: Young scientists are coming to the fore in climate research.
words.patZh: 年轻科学家正在气候研究中崭露头角。

c: weather forecast 天气预报
sales forecast 销售预测
forecast ... for ... 预测…将…
words.dif: forecast 基于数据与模型（天气、经济）；predict 是通用的'预言'
words.pat: No forecast can replace the habit of preparing for the worst.
words.patZh: 任何预报都无法替代做最坏打算的习惯。

c: foresee ... doing ... 预见…会…
as far as one can foresee 就所能预见的
words.dif: foresee 强调事先'看见'结果；anticipate 还含'预先应对'的意思
words.pat: Few could foresee how deeply the internet would reshape daily life.
words.patZh: 几乎没人能预见互联网会如此深刻地重塑日常生活。

c: forge ahead 奋勇向前
forge a link between ... 在…之间建立联系
forge a signature 伪造签名
words.dif: forge 既有'锻造、铸就'的褒义，也有'伪造'的贬义，靠宾语区分
words.pat: Shared hardship can forge the strongest friendships.
words.patZh: 共同的艰难能铸就最牢固的友谊。

words.exam: 非常严肃的；严厉的；令人不愉快的
c: a grim picture 严峻的景象
the grim reality 残酷的现实
a grim smile 苦笑
words.dif: grim 强调'严峻到令人不安'；harsh 强调苛刻；bleak 强调前景暗淡无望
words.pat: Facing the grim facts is the first step toward changing them.
words.patZh: 直面严峻的现实，是改变现实的第一步。

c: have a good grasp of ... 精通…
grasp the meaning 领会意思
grasp ... firmly 紧紧抓住…
words.dif: grasp 指'彻底理解'抽象事物；grip 多指物理上的紧握；seize 强调突然抓住
words.pat: A good teacher helps students grasp ideas, not just memorize them.
words.patZh: 好老师帮助学生领会思想，而不只是死记硬背。

c: grip ... tightly 紧紧握住…
in the grip of ... 受…控制
lose one's grip 失去掌控
words.dif: grip 比 grasp 更强调'握得死紧'；grasp 还能接抽象宾语（理解）
words.pat: A gripping story can hold an audience for hours.
words.patZh: 扣人心弦的故事能让观众沉浸几个小时。

c: gross income 总收入
gross domestic product (GDP) 国内生产总值
a gross error 严重的错误
words.dif: gross 指'未扣除成本税费的总额'；net 是'净额'，二者常成对出现
words.pat: The firm's gross income rose, though its net profit fell.
words.patZh: 这家公司的总收入上升了，净利润却下降了。

c: on the ground of ... 以…为理由
gain ground 取得进展
common ground 共同基础
words.dif: ground 作'理由'常用复数 grounds；reason 是通用词；basis 强调抽象依据
words.pat: Trust is the ground on which all cooperation is built.
words.patZh: 信任是一切合作赖以建立的根基。

words.exam: 组；群；集团；把…分类；把…分组
c: a group of ... 一群…
group ... by ... 按…把…分组
focus group 焦点小组
words.dif: group 是最通用的'组、群'；team 强调协作；gang 多含贬义
words.pat: The students were grouped by interest rather than by age.
words.patZh: 学生们按兴趣而不是按年龄分组。

c: guarantee ... against ... 保证…免受…
a guarantee of quality 质量保证
under guarantee 在保修期内
words.dif: guarantee 带'担保兑现'的契约色彩；ensure 只是'确保'；promise 是口头允诺
words.pat: Hard work does not guarantee success, but it makes success possible.
words.patZh: 努力并不保证成功，但它让成功成为可能。

c: guard ... against ... 防范…
on guard 警惕；站岗
off one's guard 放松警惕
words.dif: guard 强调'看守防范'；protect 是通用的'保护'；defend 强调抵御攻击
words.pat: We must guard against the slow erosion of public trust.
words.patZh: 我们必须防范公众信任的缓慢流失。

words.exam: 包括；包含；使成为…的一部分
c: include ... in ... 把…列入…
including prep. 包括…在内
taxes included 含税费
words.dif: include 强调整体中'含有若干部分'；contain 指容器内'装有'；comprise 较正式
words.pat: A good plan should include room for failure and recovery.
words.patZh: 好的计划应当为失败与补救留出空间。

c: an inclusive policy 包容性的政策
inclusive of ... 包含…在内的
an inclusive price 全包价
words.dif: inclusive 强调'不遗漏任何一方'；comprehensive 强调'内容全面'
words.pat: An inclusive workplace makes better use of every talent.
words.patZh: 包容的职场能更好地用好每一份才干。

c: annual income 年收入
live within one's income 量入为出
a source of income 收入来源
fam: incoming adj. 新来的；即将上任的
words.dif: income 泛指个人或机构的收入；salary 专指月薪；revenue 多指企业、政府营收
words.pat: For many families, education is the surest path to a higher income.
words.patZh: 对许多家庭来说，教育是通往更高收入最稳的路。

c: incorporate ... into ... 把…并入…
incorporate ... with ... 把…与…合并
fam: incorporation n. 合并；注册成立
words.dif: incorporate 强调'使之成为整体的一部分'；merge 强调两方对等融合
words.pat: The new textbook incorporates feedback from hundreds of teachers.
words.patZh: 新教材吸收了数百位教师的反馈。

c: increase by 20% 增长了20%
increase to ... 增至…
on the increase 在增长中
words.dif: increase 可及物可不及物；rise 只作不及物动词（不接宾语）
words.pat: Small daily improvements increase the odds of long-term success.
words.patZh: 每天微小的进步会提高长期成功的几率。

c: increasingly important 日益重要
become increasingly popular 越来越受欢迎
words.dif: increasingly 后接形容词或副词；more and more 更口语
words.pat: Critical thinking is becoming increasingly valuable in the age of AI.
words.patZh: 在人工智能时代，批判性思维正变得日益宝贵。

c: an incredible story 不可思议的故事
at incredible speed 以惊人的速度
words.dif: incredible 口语里常表赞叹'太棒了'；incredulous 形容人'不相信的'，勿混
words.pat: It is incredible what a team can do when trust is present.
words.patZh: 当信任存在时，一个团队能做到的事令人难以置信。

c: incur costs 承担费用
incur debts 负债
incur sb's anger 惹某人生气
words.dif: incur 后接的多是负面事物（损失、债务、怒火）；cause 是通用的'引起'
words.pat: Careless expansion may incur debts that a firm cannot repay.
words.patZh: 盲目的扩张可能招致企业无力偿还的债务。

c: link ... to / with ... 把…与…联系起来
a link between ... and ... …与…之间的联系
a weak link 薄弱环节
words.dif: link 强调'环节式的连接'；connect 泛指各种连接；bond 强调情感纽带
words.pat: Researchers have found a clear link between sleep and memory.
words.patZh: 研究者发现了睡眠与记忆之间明确的联系。

words.exam: 表；目录；清单；名单；把…列成清单；列举
c: make a list of ... 列一份…的清单
on the list 在名单上
top the list 位居榜首
fam: listing n. 列表；清单条目
words.dif: list 是最通用的'清单'；catalogue 指带分类的目录；menu 专指菜单
words.pat: Writing a short list of priorities can calm a busy mind.
words.patZh: 列一份简短的优先事项清单，能让忙碌的心安定下来。

c: take ... literally 按字面理解…
literally speaking 照字面说
words.dif: literally 本义是'照字面地'，口语中也作强调'简直、确实'；勿与 liberally（慷慨地）混淆
words.pat: Some idioms cannot be understood literally.
words.patZh: 有些习语不能按字面意思理解。

c: literary criticism 文学批评
a literary figure 文学人物
literary works 文学作品
words.dif: literary 与'文学'相关；literal 是'字面的'，二者形近义远
words.pat: Her literary taste was shaped by the novels of her childhood.
words.patZh: 她的文学品味是由童年读过的小说塑造的。

c: modern literature 现代文学
the literature on ... 关于…的文献
read literature 阅读文学作品
words.dif: literature 既指'文学'也指学术'文献'（review the literature 文献综述）
words.pat: Good literature teaches us to see through other eyes.
words.patZh: 好的文学教会我们透过别人的眼睛看世界。

c: write a memo 写备忘录
an internal memo 内部备忘录
words.dif: memo 是 memorandum 的口语缩略，指公务便条；note 泛指任何便条
words.pat: A clear memo saves a hundred unnecessary meetings.
words.patZh: 一份清晰的备忘录能省去一百场不必要的会议。

c: a memorial service 追悼会
a war memorial 战争纪念碑
a memorial hall 纪念堂
words.dif: memorial 作名词是'纪念物'，作形容词是'纪念的'；monument 多指宏伟的纪念碑
words.pat: The memorial stands as a quiet reminder of shared sacrifice.
words.patZh: 这座纪念碑静静矗立，提醒人们共同的牺牲。

words.exam: 记忆；记忆力；回忆；存储（器）
c: in memory of ... 为纪念…
a good memory 好记性
childhood memories 童年回忆
words.dif: memory 泛指记忆与回忆；recollection 强调'努力回想出来的'片段
words.pat: Stories live longer in memory than bare facts do.
words.patZh: 故事在记忆中比干巴巴的事实活得更久。

c: mental health 心理健康
mental arithmetic 心算
a mental picture 脑海中的画面
words.dif: mental 泛指'心理、脑力'；physical 是其常用反义（physical health 身体健康）
words.pat: Mental strength grows each time we face what we fear.
words.patZh: 每一次直面恐惧，心理力量就增长一分。

c: mention ... to sb 向某人提起…
not to mention ... 更不用说…
don't mention it 别客气
words.dif: mention 指'顺带一提'；refer to 更正式，指'提及、指代'
words.pat: As the report mentions, trust takes years to build and seconds to lose.
words.patZh: 正如报告所提到的，信任建立需数年，失去只需一瞬。

c: act as a mentor 担任导师
a mentor to ... …的导师
fam: mentorship n. 导师制；指导关系
words.dif: mentor 强调长期的言传身教；coach 偏重技能训练；adviser 偏重提供建议
words.pat: Behind many a success stands a patient mentor.
words.patZh: 许多成功背后都站着一位耐心的导师。

words.exam: 另外的；其他的；其他人或物
c: each other 互相
the other day 前几天
other than 除了
words.dif: other 后接名词；another 接单数名词；others 单独作代词用
words.pat: Real confidence lets us learn from other people's success.
words.patZh: 真正的自信让我们能从别人的成功中学习。

words.exam: 要不然；否则；不同地；用别的方法；在其他方面
c: or otherwise 或以其他方式
unless otherwise stated 除非另有说明
words.dif: otherwise 作'否则'是连词；作'以别的方式'是副词，词性决定用法
words.pat: Back up your files regularly; otherwise one accident may erase years of work.
words.patZh: 定期备份文件，否则一次意外可能抹去数年的心血。

c: the outcome of ... …的结果
a positive outcome 积极的结果
predict the outcome 预测结果
words.dif: outcome 强调过程走到终点的'最终结局'；result 是通用词；consequence 多指不良后果
words.pat: The outcome of an experiment matters less than what it teaches.
words.patZh: 实验的结果不如它教给我们的东西重要。

words.exam: 标记；符号；招牌；征兆；迹象；签名（于）
c: sign a contract 签合同
a sign of ... …的迹象
sign up for ... 报名参加…
words.dif: sign 泛指'记号、迹象'；signal 强调有意发出的信号；symbol 强调象征意义
words.pat: A willingness to listen is often the first sign of wisdom.
words.patZh: 乐于倾听常常是智慧最初的迹象。

c: put one's signature on ... 在…上签名
a signature dish 招牌菜
a forged signature 伪造的签名
words.dif: signature 指法律文件上的签名；autograph 指名人的亲笔签名
words.pat: Her signature at the bottom of the page marked a new beginning.
words.patZh: 她在页末的签名标志着一个新的开始。

c: send a signal 发出信号
a clear signal 明确的信号
signal to sb to do sth 示意某人做某事
words.dif: signal 强调'有意传递信息的信号'；sign 泛指一切迹象，包括无意的
words.pat: Falling sales signal a need to rethink the whole strategy.
words.patZh: 下滑的销量标志着有必要重新思考整体战略。

c: the significance of ... …的意义
attach significance to ... 重视…
of great significance 意义重大
words.dif: significance 兼有'意义'与'重要性'；importance 只指重要性
words.pat: The significance of a habit lies in what it compounds into.
words.patZh: 一个习惯的意义在于它日积月累所复利而成的东西。

c: a significant change 重大变化
a significant number of ... 相当多的…
statistically significant 具有统计显著性
words.dif: significant 强调'值得注意、影响大'；important 是通用的'重要'
words.pat: Small daily choices can have a significant impact on health.
words.patZh: 每天微小的选择也会对健康产生重大影响。

c: signify ... by ... 以…表示…
signify agreement 表示同意
words.dif: signify 是正式的'表示、意味着'；mean 是通用词；indicate 强调'指示、显示'
words.pat: A nod may signify agreement, but real consent needs words.
words.patZh: 点头或许表示同意，但真正的认可需要言语。

c: be similar to ... 与…相似
similar in ... 在…方面相似
a similar case 类似的案例
words.dif: be similar to 的介词固定用 to；same 前必须加 the（the same as）
words.pat: Two similar products may differ greatly in after-sales service.
words.patZh: 两款相似的产品，售后服务可能天差地别。

c: a simple solution 简单的解决办法
keep it simple 保持简单
a simple life 简朴的生活
words.dif: simple 指'不复杂'；easy 指'不费力'，二者常可互换但侧重不同
words.pat: The best explanation is often the simple one that survives testing.
words.patZh: 最好的解释，往往是经得起检验的那个简单解释。

c: for simplicity 为简洁起见
the beauty of simplicity 简洁之美
words.dif: simplicity 是'简单'这一性质的名词；simplification 指'简化'这一过程
words.pat: Simplicity is not the absence of thought but its finest product.
words.patZh: 简洁不是思想的缺席，而是思想最精致的产物。

c: simplify ... for sb 为某人简化…
simplify the procedure 精简流程
words.dif: simplify 指'化繁为简'；oversimplify 指'过度简化'以致失真，带贬义
words.pat: To simplify a rule is to make it usable by everyone.
words.patZh: 把一条规则化繁为简，就是让每个人都能用上它。

c: simply because 仅仅因为
put it simply 简而言之
words.dif: simply 作'仅仅'时近 merely；作'简直'时是强调语气词（simply wonderful）
words.pat: Some problems are hard not because they are complex but simply because we avoid them.
words.patZh: 有些问题难，不是因为复杂，只是因为我们一直在回避。

words.exam: 松弛的；松懈的；萧条的；淡季
c: a slack season 淡季
slack off 偷懒；松懈
take up the slack 收紧松弛部分；补位
words.dif: slack 既可指绳子'松'，也可指生意'淡'、纪律'懈'；loose 只指物理上的松
words.pat: A good manager keeps standards high even when business is slack.
words.patZh: 优秀的管理者即使在生意萧条时也保持高标准。
